results.text: From the respect paid her on all sides, she seemed like a queen, and from the adoration with which she was treated by two or three, she appeared an object of worship. The Queen Mother gave the French the most affectionate reception. France was her native country, and she had suffered too much unhappiness in England for England to have made her forget France.

results.text: She taught her daughter, then, by her own affection for it that love for a country where they had both been hospitably received and where a brilliant future opened for them.

results.text: You will be frank with me. I always am.

results.text: Can you imagine why Buckingham has been so violent? I suspect.

results.text: It is you, Hermes. Stacon Rowl I have read his distress in his eyes in his every gesture and action the whole day.

results.text: I can perceive love clearly enough.

results.text: In those very terms, I even added more.

results.text: But continued Rau, not interrupted by this movement of his friend, Heaven be praised the French who are pronounced to be thoughtless and indiscreet, reckless even, are capable of bringing a calm and sound judgment to bear on matters of such high importance.
